title: Opening
narration: Iron Ore Conveyor Digital Twin is a real-time operational view of conveyor C01.

title: Live HMI
narration: The interface brings a live three-dimensional conveyor, operator controls, KPIs, and alarm status into one focused workspace.

title: Fault simulation
narration: The built-in simulator lets an operator safely introduce conditions and observe how the model responds.

title: Asset diagnostics
narration: The asset inspector turns live signals into an individual health view with failure probability and contributing factors.

title: Analytics
narration: Analytics preserves the live signal history across key operating metrics and a visual health matrix.

title: Alarms
narration: The alarm workflow makes event severity visible, filterable, and ready for acknowledgement.

title: Maintenance
narration: Maintenance recommendations connect operational risk to prioritized work.

title: Technology stack
narration: Built with React, TypeScript, Three.js, FastAPI, WebSockets, Zustand, Recharts, and SQLite.

title: Closing
narration: Iron Ore Conveyor Digital Twin: a practical HMI for observing, testing, and responding to conveyor health in real time.
